system.description:
You detect whether the target is infected with a biological nanovirus or nanoplague strain of the exsurgent virus — or if they are an async. You know only whether or not the target is infected; superior successes may provide gut feelings about the target’s specific strain and its effects.

GM note: under no circumstances should you provide the name of the strain — focus on its nature.

effectsToTarget.description: Detect exsurgent infection in biological life.
